summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting open-market share repurchases as part of an existing buyback programme announced on 16 February 2026. The company purchased 2,749,797 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of 549.2 GBp per share. Shares were bought through UBS AG, London Branch on multiple venues (LSE, CHIX, BATE). Repurchased shares will be cancelled, reducing share count. This is a routine return of capital to shareholders; no premium, tender offer, or special dividend is involved. Watch for continued execution under the programme.
